title: Full rollout vs paid pilot after a single demo
question: Global Freight Systems have asked about rolling out across all 14 depots after one demo. What should we do this quarter?

options.label: Push for the 14-depot rollout contract this quarter
Propose a paid two-depot pilot with defined success criteria
Book a qualification meeting with the budget holder before proposing anything

claims.statement: Six operations staff attended the demo; two follow-up emails were sent.
Operations staff describe an 11 hour per week manual reconciliation process at the demoed depot.
All 14 depots are assumed to run the same reconciliation process as the depot demoed.
The operations manager confirmed he does not control spend and would not name the budget holder.
Two comparable multi-site rollouts took five months and required IT sign-off that was not in the original scope.
The operations manager described the demo as 'exactly what we need'.

unknowns.question: Who controls the budget for a 14-depot rollout, and what is the approval threshold?
Do all 14 depots actually run the same process as the one demoed?

hidden.actual_decision_label: Propose a paid two-depot pilot with defined success criteria
hidden.reasoning_notes: SYNTHETIC. One demo is not proof at 14 sites, the process is unverified beyond one depot, and nobody who can approve spend has been in the room. A paid pilot buys the proof and forces the budget holder to surface.
